title: GCC simulation and analysis code
description: Software archive for the Gamma-Code Consensus (GCC) project. Version v1.3.2 adds the final Neuroscience of Consciousness-oriented manuscript and supplement, the Chennu 2016 gamma baseline-holdout analysis with Cambridge raw-data manifest, the Hermann 2021 FDG-PET/EEG disorders-of-consciousness proxy analysis with paired AUC-delta controls, the corrected Zenodo concept DOI metadata, and direct frozen-tag GitHub links in the manuscript files.
